_doc: Stage 6.0.3 - the CI pytest groups. Every tests/test_*.py file belongs to EXACTLY ONE group; scripts/ci_pytest_groups.py check
fails when a file is missing, listed twice or does not exist, and tests/test_ci_groups_603.py runs that check in every group.
Groups are balanced by the runtime MEASURED ON THE RUNNER (PR #16 run 36): the SQLite-heavy execution / account-refresh / cash-flow
files run 6-25x slower there than locally (the model campaign alone is 27 % of the local suite but only 1.2x slower on the runner),
so they are three jobs. The Windows-only files (runner, smoke, desktop notifications) stay together. Job names are the stable check names.

core.about: strategy lab, backtests, evidence, explanations, scanner, briefs, Trader View, PPE, Demand, Stage 2.7-3.x surfaces, the CI manifest itself

execution.about: setups -> proposals -> safety gate -> autonomous paper execution (Stages 5.8, 5.9, 5.9.1, 6.0)

account.about: continuous account refresh and the cash-flow ledger (Stages 6.0.1, 6.0.2): two long simulated-session tests

paper.about: Alpaca paper reads and manual orders (Stages 4.5, 4.6, 4.6B; the Stage 4.6B step runs first in this job), portfolio, trade review

research.about: signal research, rotation diagnostics / engine / handoff / store / API, research workflow, portfolio backtest, strategy validation harness

campaign.about: the Stage 5.0 model campaign: the single heaviest file locally (about a quarter of the whole suite)

validation.about: Stage 6.1 forward paper validation: the observer, session health, funnel / reliability / safety statistics, reports, exports and the Stage 6.1 freeze

runner.about: Windows-only: the background runner (real offline processes), the standalone AAPL paper smoke (simulated), desktop notifications
